about: What the screen reader should say at each step of tools/a11y/nvda-session.mjs and voiceover-session.mjs with fixtures/t/reading.md open. The designs are the owner's choices from session 1 (ADR-0028): announcements through the live region, heard once; the spoken word marked by a background color, the caret at its start. A must entry fails the run when no phrase of that step matches its pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression); a should entry is a warning. once: true warns when the pattern is heard more than once in the step.

open.why: NVDA names the window or the document when the window takes the focus
the app's startup announcement; ADR-0028 found it can be lost before a client connects, but a running screen reader connects sooner

read.why: Play is announced through the live region

pause.why: Pause is announced once, through the live region (session 1)

heading.why: h moves to the next heading; NVDA or the app says its text

settings.why: the settings dialog is named, and NVDA says it when the focus moves in
the first section in the list, with its size ("Speech, 20 settings")

close.why: Escape closes the dialog and the focus returns to the document
